title: issue 587
why: The listener's message logged unredacted: a key in an address it quotes reaches the supervisor's log line whole.

title: after giving up, starts again with the whole restart budget
why: A retry that keeps the failures it gave up on (issue 562): its first failure is the fifth in a row, and the supervisor gives up again at once instead of restarting three times.

title: is refused while the engine it gave up on is still being ended
why: An engine being ended not counted as still ending (issues 562, 637): a retry let through while the engine given up on is still being ended starts a second engine on the same home beside one that has not yet gone, and the reset removes the home's folders under it.

title: is refused while that child lives
why: An engine that outlived the last wait after SIGKILL not counted as still ending (issues 562, 637): a retry starts a second engine on the same home while the first is still there, and the reset removes the home's folders under it.

title: ends it on SIGTERM, well within terminateMs, then restarts
why: No terminate for what an engine left running as it exited (issue 640): a tool that would have stopped cleanly runs on, writing into the home, until the kill comes a whole terminateMs later.

title: kills it within terminateMs of the terminate when it ignores SIGTERM, before the next engine starts
why: No kill after the terminate (issue 640): a tool the engine left that ignores SIGTERM runs on beside the next engine, and past the app.

title: kills it within terminateMs of the terminate when it ignores SIGTERM, before the next engine starts
why: A restart that does not wait for the old engine's group (issue 640): the new engine starts on the same home while a tool the old one left is still writing into it.

title: refuses a retry, and a quit waits, while what an engine it gave up on left is ended
why: What an exited engine left running not counted as still ending (issues 640, 637): a person's Try again starts a new engine beside its tools on the same home, and the reset removes the folders they write into.

title: ends, before a quit resolves, what an engine left as it stopped as asked
why: A quit that does not wait for the engine's group (issue 640): the app exits before the kill is sent, and a tool that ignores SIGTERM outlives it.

title: ends, before a quit resolves, what an engine left as it stopped as asked
why: Only an exit nobody asked for has its group ended (issue 640): an engine that stops as asked, on a quit or after a failure, leaves its tools running past it.

title: keeps nothing for a group that was empty, before the stdio has closed
why: No look at the group as the exit is seen (issue 640): an empty one is kept and waited on until a later look, and its id can pass to another process before that look takes it for the engine's.

title: has a quit wait too for a group added while it waits
why: A wait that takes the groups there when it began (issue 640): an engine that outlived the kill and exits meanwhile leaves its group unwaited, and the quit resolves with it still running.

title: has read the last stderr line written before the pipe closed
why: The group signalled as the exit is seen, not once it is reported (issue 640): a child of the engine still holding its stderr pipe is ended before it writes its last line, and the log loses what the engine's side printed on its way out.

title: starts no engine while the data is reset, and starts it once the reset has ended
why: A restart that does not ask about the reset (issue 637): its wait ends during a reset of the engine's data and an engine starts on the home whose folders are being removed, writing into them and asked for feeds.list as it settles.

title: starts no engine while the data is reset, and starts it once the reset has ended
why: A restart that found a reset running and never looks again (issue 637): the engine stays restarting after the reset has ended, and only a quit and a reopen start it.

title: leaves no timer and starts nothing once a stop comes during the wait
why: A quit that leaves the restart's timer armed (issue 637): the wait for a reset goes on looking past the stop, held off only by the callback's own check of stopping.

find:
const reset = this.options.resetting()
    if (reset !== null) return reset
title: refuses a retry while the engine data is being reset, with the reset’s sentence
why: The supervisor's retry not checked against the reset (issue 637): any caller but the bridge, whose own check stands in front, starts an engine on the home whose folders are being removed.

title: has the reset refused while the engine is starting or restarting
why: A reset let through while the engine is restarting (issue 637): nothing is in flight while a restart waits, the reset begins, and the two run together; while starting the handshake refuses it, but as a request being answered, not as the start it is.

title: has the reset refused while the group is being ended
why: The reset not asking whether anything is still being ended (issue 637, from issue 640's review): a tool still running in an exited engine's group writes into the folders the reset removes.

title: has the reset refused, as a retry is, while the engine given up on is still being ended
why: An engine being ended not counted as still ending (issue 637, the regression its second commit fixed): the engine given up on is still being ended, for up to shutdownMs and two terminateMs, with no client and so nothing in flight, and the reset removes the four folders under a live engine while a retry is refused.

title: starts no engine while the data is reset, and starts it once the reset has ended
why: The wait's sentence put in place of the failure's reason (issue 637): while the restart waits for a reset, the screen no longer says why the engine stopped.

title: says the wait again when a later restart meets a later reset
why: The record of a wait for a reset never cleared (issue 637): a later restart that meets a later reset keeps the failure's reason alone, says nothing of the wait, and logs nothing of it.
